### Layout  
- A large rectangular panel with rounded corners dominates the center of the screen, set against the dark blue background. This panel has three vertical sections: left (statistical information), middle (game play area), and right (control buttons).  

### Visible Text & Elements  
#### Top Center  
- The word “TETRIS” appears in light gray, centered above the main panel.  

#### Left Section (Statistical Information)  
- A dark gray rectangle labeled **“Next Piece”** (teal text) sits at the top; below it is a larger empty white rectangle where future pieces would appear.  
- Below this, a smaller dark gray rectangle displays:  
  - “Score” (teal text), with “0” (white number) beneath it.  
- Next, another dark gray rectangle shows:  
  - “Level” (teal text), with “1” (white number) beneath it.  
- The bottom left element is a dark gray rectangle with:  
  - “Lines Cleared” (teal text), with “0” (white number) beneath it.  

#### Middle Section (Game Play Area)  
- A large rectangular area outlined by a thin teal border, filled with solid black. It contains no Tetris pieces or game elements.  

#### Right Section (Control Buttons)  
- Four vertically stacked orange buttons with white icons and text:  
  - Top button: left arrow icon + “Left”  
  - Second button: rotate symbol (two arrows in a circle) + “Rotate”  
  - Third button: right arrow icon + “Right”  
  - Bottom button: down arrow icon + “Drop”  

### Colors & Styling  
- The central panel’s background is dark gray.  
- Text labels for stats (“Next Piece,” “Score,” etc.) are teal.  
- Numbers in stats boxes (0, 1) and button text/icons are white.  
- Control buttons have an orange-to-light-orange gradient fill.  
- The play area border is a thin teal line.

- No elements overlap or appear broken; all sections maintain consistent spacing and alignment.  
- The “Next Piece” box, score/level/lines boxes, controls, and play area are distinct with clear boundaries.

            color: white;

            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

            backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
            position: relative;
        }
        
        .game-container::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -2px;
            left: -2px;
            right: -2px;
            bottom: -2px;

            border-radius: 18px;
            padding: 20px;

            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }
        
        .next-piece h3 {

transcript.summary:
Built a fully-featured Tetris game as a single self-contained HTML file (tetris.html). The game includes:

**Game Features:**
- Visible 10x20 playing field with teal border
- All seven standard tetromino pieces (I, O, T, S, Z, J, L) in vibrant colors
- Piece rotation with wall kick functionality
- Left/right movement via arrow keys or on-screen buttons
- Gravity that increases with level
- Line clearing with scoring system
- Score, Level, and Lines Cleared displays

**Visual Design:**
- Animated gradient background (yellow → green → purple)
- 3D block rendering with highlights and shadows
- Responsive control panel with hover effects
- Next piece preview window
- Game over overlay with restart button
- Clean, modern UI with proper spacing and typography

The game is fully functional - pieces fall automatically, can be moved/rotated, lines are cleared when complete, and the score updates accordingly. All controls work via keyboard arrows or mouse buttons.
